name: Work IQ
short_description: Work IQ is Microsoft's intelligence layer that grounds Microsoft 365 Copilot and agents in an organization's work context and data.

evidence.quote: So before work, IQ, you had like graph
all of this that Microsoft calls work IQ. It gives agents the context of your job, your team, and your company
